bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for culturally specific peer recovery and outreach programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CULTURALLY SPECIFIC PEER RECOVERY AND OUTREACH PROGRAMS. +]

[+(a) $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Generation Hope. The funds must be used to enhance culturally specific peer recovery and outreach programs, including: +]

[+(1) expanding culturally relevant peer recovery support services to meet the diverse needs of individuals in recovery; +]

[+(2) conducting targeted outreach to underserved communities to increase access to recovery resources; +]

[+(3) providing training and professional development for peer recovery specialists to ensure culturally informed care; and +]

[+(4) partnering with community-based organizations to strengthen connections and provide wraparound support services for participants. +]

[+(b) This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for culturally specific peer recovery and outreach programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CULTURALLY SPECIFIC PEER RECOVERY AND OUTREACH PROGRAMS.

(a) $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Generation Hope. The funds must be used to enhance culturally specific peer recovery and outreach programs, including:

(1) expanding culturally relevant peer recovery support services to meet the diverse needs of individuals in recovery;

(2) conducting targeted outreach to underserved communities to increase access to recovery resources;

(3) providing training and professional development for peer recovery specialists to ensure culturally informed care; and

(4) partnering with community-based organizations to strengthen connections and provide wraparound support services for participants.

(b) This is a onetime appropriation.
